test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct active form of the given sentence.

The meal will have been made ready by the cook by the time you reach the guest house.

options.text: The cook will have made the meal ready by the time you reach the guest house.
The cook will be making the meal ready by the time you reach the guest house.
The cook will make the meal ready by the time you reach the guest house.
The cook have made the meal ready by the time you reach the guest house.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the passive voice is used, which needs to be converted into the active voice.
 
• The subject of the passive sentence '**the cook' **becomes the **subject **of the **active sentence.**
 
• The object of the passive sentence '**the meal'** becomes the** object** of the active sentence.
 
• The verb tense "will have been made ready" is **converted** to "will have made ready" in the active voice.
 
• Format of active voice : **Subject + main verb ( here future perfect tense) + Object**

Hence, the correct active format is '***The cook will have made the meal ready by the time you reach the guest house*.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The passive voice is used to emphasize the action rather than the subject, while the** active voice** emphasizes the subject performing the action.
 
• In general, the **active voice is more direct and vigorous than the passive voice**.
 
• Converting sentences from passive to active voice often makes the sentence clearer and more concise.
 
 
• **Example: *The letter was written by John* (passive)**
 
 

 ** *John wrote the letter* (active).**
